_contract.limit: Each measured count <= 1.20 * B, except sidecar reuse (reused.*), judged by rate: each kind's reused / (reused + reloaded) >= baseline rate / 1.20, both denominators positive; quiet sidecar reuse >=95% with positive denominator; observed zero of a capped counter remains zero, missing defined-platform observations fail.

fallbacks.sidecar_read_bytes: existing per-kind reload counts; no native sidecar byte tally on this revision
fallbacks.sqlite_cache_write_pages: encoded_bytes from existing save_work tally; pages unavailable on this revision

meanings.encoded_bytes: Existing save_work dirty_bytes logical charge, including row/key overhead; not exact encoded bytes, SQLite pages or physical writes.
meanings.log_bytes: Actual serialized resource-diagnostic writer bytes including prefix/newline; other stderr and test-runner output are outside this counter.
meanings.native_bytes: Completed native acquisition reads; discovery, failed plans, joins and sidecar reads are outside this existing page counter.

_contract.regeneration: CI only: dispatch resource-regression.yml with record_baseline=true on current-main production plus these test adapters; extract resource_baseline_counts JSON. Review exact counts and pinned main SHA; baseline raises require a reviewed PR. Physical process I/O is macOS sampler_v6 RC evidence only.
